jobs.description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving 

A high-quality food company that delivers fresh products daily to hospitality clients and large-scale kitchens. The 300 employees work together day after day to make this possible. This market leader not only takes care of its customers, but also of its employees. Quality always comes first, which is why regular training is provided.

What does your working day look like as a Frozen Warehouse Worker?

 
• 
Restocking the frozen storage areas: you place incoming goods in the correct locations according to the warehouse layout

 
• 
You work with a handheld scanner that registers all movements

 
• 
You pick the correct goods and prepare them for transport, based on customer orders

 
• 
You perform accurate picking tasks by selecting the right products and efficiently preparing them for shipment

 
• 
You work according to a fixed schedule: Monday to Thursday from 12:00 PM to 9:30 PM, and Sunday from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM. This gives you a fixed schedule every week

Who are we looking for as a Frozen Warehouse Worker?

 
• 
Physically fit: you can comfortably lift boxes weighing up to 20 kg

 
• 
You are comfortable working in a frozen environment and can work effectively in temperatures as low as -25°C while wearing appropriate protective clothing

 
• 
Experience in logistics or as a warehouse worker is a plus

 
• 
You pay close attention to quality

 
• 
You communicate good in Dutch or English to correctly follow up on order forms

jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Business Analyst Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

 

The cream recipe:

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues
Your future projects 

Like Teddy, Business Analyst Business Intelligence at Cream, translate the BI needs of the business teams in specifications for the IT department, for both small demands or as part of larger projects (contributions or BI project). Your tasks will be

• Act as person of contact between Business Engineering Teams and the Development Team

• Define the business specifications for BI needs

• Participation in (or management of) BI projects, or on the BI tracks of other projects for the engineering activities (requirement definition, impact analysis, process definition), while representing the BI vision (and BI target architecture) that has been defined

• Collaboration with data delivery experts to deliver on projects

• Understand business requirements and build a functional analysis which covers needs of the business according to our BI reference architecture

• Collaborate with the development team

What do we expect from our Consultant ?

• You have a Master degree in Computer Sciences or equivalent by experience

• You have at least 2 years of experience in data and business analysis

• You have good knowledge in BI techniques and tools (BO, SAS, Cognos...)

• You have a cultural openness and adaptability, you are rigorous, customer oriented, and you have high communication skills and analytical skills

• You are polyvalent and can adapt easily to quickly changing environment

• You are capable to think out of the box and maintain in the meantime a pragmatic approach

• You are able to work with autonomy while being also a great team player

• You are fluent in French and English; a good knowledge of Dutch is an asset

• You are committed to travelling abroad occasionally upon the client's request

jobs.occupation: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

jobs.occupation: In-House Legal Counsel - Flemish Brabant - Self-employed
jobs.description:
Our client is a niche advisory organisation that supports individuals in managing key aspects of their professional and financial activities.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage the legal side of transactions from start to finish
• Draft, review and negotiate contracts and related documentation
• Analyse tax and social law implications within transactional files
• Identify risks, inconsistencies and optimisation opportunities
• Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders throughout the process
• Maintain rigorous structure, documentation and follow-up
• Provide tailored, high-quality advice (no "one-size-fits-all")

• Master of Laws with 2-8 years' experience, ideally in M&A or tax
• Strong negotiation skills and the ability to challenge positions when needed
• Excellent attention to detail and a sharp ability to detect inconsistencies
• Robust tax reflexes and a naturally transactional mindset
• Professional, assertive and confident - able to stand your ground
• Pragmatic, clear, no-nonsense communicator
• Comfortable with variable workload and able to self-manage peaks
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English
• Proactive, structured and ownership-driven

What you'll do :
 
 

• Understand clients' business needs and translate them into clear, feasible end-to-end AI solutions 

• Act as a trusted point of contact for clients throughout the project, from scoping to delivery 

• Run discovery sessions and technical workshops with business and technical stakeholders 

• Design and build AI solutions combining LLMs, vector databases, APIs, orchestration layers and user interfaces 

• Develop agents and RAG pipelines connecting client data to LLMs for grounded, reliable answers 

• Perform prompt and context engineering to improve output quality and reduce hallucinations 

• Build, train and evaluate classical ML models (classification, regression, forecasting, clustering) when they are the best fit for the problem 

• Handle the data side: gathering, cleaning, validating data quality and feature engineering 

• Evaluate solutions rigorously, using ML metrics, generative AI metrics and production monitoring (quality, drift, costs) 

• Deploy solutions to the cloud with attention to security, reliability and cost efficiency, including versioning and reproducibility of models and data 

• Present and explain AI concepts, trade-offs and results to non-technical audiences 

• Support sales in qualifying opportunities, estimating effort and writing proposals 

• Contribute to demos, proofs of concept and internal knowledge sharing 

Who we're looking for :
 
 

• You hold a Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related field 

• You have 2 to 5 years of experience in AI/ML engineering or related fields 

• You're proficient in Python and software development best practices 

• You have strong machine learning fundamentals: supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model validation and the statistics behind them 

• You have hands-on experience with the Python data and ML stack: Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) 

• You have a solid understanding of LLM fundamentals: Transformers, generation parameters, RAG and fine-tuning approaches 

• You have hands-on experience with tools such as the OpenAI API, Hugging Face, LangChain/LangGraph, FastAPI and Docker 

• You're comfortable working with data in SQL databases 

• You're a natural consultant: you listen, ask the right questions and see the business behind the technical problem 

• You're comfortable presenting to clients and explaining complex topics simply 

• You have strong problem-solving ability and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset 

• You have a team spirit and enjoy collaborating across multiple roles 

• You're autonomous, curious, and quick to learn new tools 

• You can communicate fluently in English and French or Dutch

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver – Sea Container Transport
jobs.description:
Job description 

You will transport sea containers on dedicated shuttle and short-haul routes between the major port terminals and various warehouses throughout the Port of Antwerp.

As the majority of your work involves local shuttle runs between warehouses and terminals, you can avoid long motorway traffic jams while keeping your schedule tight, efficient, and predictable.

You will work confidently with the various terminal systems and carefully check all container and seal numbers to ensure everything is correct.

Thanks to flexible departure locations, you can also avoid unnecessary commuting time. In consultation with the planning team, you can start from a strategic location in the port that is most convenient for you.

An average working day is approximately 12 hours. However, if you prefer a better work-life balance, a 4/5 employment arrangement or part-time schedule is absolutely negotiable.

You will join a stable, permanent position with a clear focus on reliable, long-term cooperation.

 Requirements 

    
• Qualifications: You hold a valid CE driving licence and an up-to-date Code 95 qualification.
    
• Language skills: You speak and understand Dutch or English well enough to communicate smoothly and effectively.
    
• Administration: You ensure the accurate and correct handling of CMR consignment notes and terminal documentation.
    
• Professional attitude: You are a serious, reliable professional who always works in a customer-friendly and presentable manner.

This Belgian manufacturer of dry powder mixtures for the construction industry (mortars, adhesives, plasters, etc.), located in the Port of Antwerp, is looking to strengthen its current team with a motivated OPERATOR.

As an OPERATOR, you will be responsible for all operational tasks required during your shift for production and loading activities. You will play a crucial role in the production process and will be widely deployable across various production lines, from mixing processes to bagging.

Your responsibilities as an OPERATOR* will include:

• Preparing, weighing and accurately dosing raw materials and additives for mixing processes, particularly liquids.
• Monitoring and operating mixing and filling machines, such as dissolvers, mixing tanks and filling equipment.
• Operating, converting and setting up bagging machines.
• Setting up and loading packaging materials (e.g. film) onto the machines.
• Carrying out process checks and visual inspections of the finished product, such as checking viscosity and colour consistency.
• Replacing simple mechanical components on the production lines.
• Processing residual product and cleaning the factory, including cleaning mixing equipment and pipelines.
• Assisting drivers during loading operations.
• Carrying out internal transport and logistical activities using a forklift and/or reach truck.

REF:MEC1

Experience & Profile

• You have proven relevant work experience as an OPERATOR in a production environment.
• Experience with mixing, dispersing or filling liquids, or operating bagging and packaging machines, is preferred.
• A valid forklift and/or reach truck certificate is a major advantage.
• You are familiar with terminology and techniques used in the mixing industry, such as batch production, dosing and basic quality control
• You have a technical aptitude and a strong problem-solving mindset.
• You are communicative and have a good command of Dutch or English

For our client, an international player within logistics with several branches worldwide and in Belgium, we are looking for a GL Accountant.

They offer various logistics solutions through their extensive network of offices, partners and warehouses.

They are looking to strengthen their team in Antwerp and are looking for a GL Accountant.

Jobomschrijving

For the position as GL Accountant at our client in the Antwerp region, we are looking for someone who is fascinated by the following range of tasks:

• You will process the complete accounting for the assigned companies and countries.
• You prepare the monthly and annual financial close of the assigned entities.
• You align accounting and operational processes.
• You will be responsible for the balance sheet analysis and monthly reconciliation of assigned entities.
• You prepare monthly, quarterly and year-end internal and group reports.
• You provide monitoring of costs, accruals and provisions in collaboration with the controlling team and local teams.
• You participate in the annual budgeting process.
• You foresee the closing of general ledger accounts and financial reporting.
• You participate in the annual external audit process if required.
• You will work closely with the Financial Controllers team in this process.
• You will always work on a country or entity based in Western Europe.

To fulfil this role of GL Accountant, you recognise yourself in the following profile:

• You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Accounting.
• You have a first experience as a GL Accountant.
• You have a strong analytical mindset and attention to detail.
• You are fluent in English.
• You have a good knowledge of balance sheet analysis, monthly, quarterly, and yearly closing processes, IFRS, and reconciliations.
• SAP experience is advantageous.
• You are a team player who thrives in an international environment.
